name: Hop Beer
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: bruised ginger root
ingredients.originalText: four ounces of bruised ginger root

instructions.text: Take five quarts of water and six ounces of hops, boil it three hours
Strain the liquor and add to it five quarts of water and four ounces of bruised ginger root
Strain and add four pounds of sugar
When luke-warm put in a pint of yeast
In twenty-four hours it will be ready for bottling

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take five quarts of water and six ounces of hops, boil it three hours
2. Strain the liquor and add to it five quarts of water and four ounces of bruised ginger root
3. Boil this again twenty minutes
4. Strain and add four pounds of sugar
5. When luke-warm put in a pint of yeast
6. Let it ferment
7. In twenty-four hours it will be ready for bottling
